exception.justification: Justified: Iterative destruction preserves the container's erasure without recursive tracing or a nesting-dependent stack limit.

review.body: { let Self :: Array (items) = self else { return ; } ; let mut work = std :: mem :: take (items) ; while let Some (mut value) = work . pop () { if let Self :: Array (items) = & mut value { work . append (items) ; } } }
review.item_premise: Protected canonical encoding or erasure inherits the secret-typed boundary; no private bytes become ordinary observed arguments.
